subject: CloudMesh operator cascade notice and potential impact on EU data residency
messages:
From: Operator Notifications <operator-notify@cloudmesh.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, security@bigbank.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudmesh.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Operator cascade notice for EU region nodes - action items and timeline

Hello Redwood and BigBank teams,

As part of an infrastructure consolidation starting Oct 4, CloudMesh will be decommissioning three operator nodes in eu-west-3 and rehoming workloads to a smaller, centralized operator fleet. The change is driven by availability of a new multi-tenant operator fabric that will automatically route tenant workloads.

Summary of impact (high level):
- Affected operator nodes: eu-west-3-ops-1, eu-west-3-ops-2, eu-west-3-ops-3
- Planned traffic shift window: Oct 4 02:00 - Oct 5 06:00 UTC
- Expected custody change: some control-plane sockets will be handled by CloudMesh-managed operator agents running in a shared tenancy; no customer data will be stored on the operator host persistent disk beyond transient cache.

Attachments: cloudmesh_operator_cascade_notice_v1.pdf (detailed mapping), eu_region_matrix_202709.xlsx (node to region mapping)

Action items for Redwood:
1) Confirm whether existing EU-only data residency commitments require us to request operator isolation or a postponement.
2) Provide contact for vendor assurance and SOC2 attestation retrieval.
3) Supply any additional contractual prohibitions on multi-tenant operator hosts.

Please reply with an estimated response window. We will accept formal exceptions and remediation plans submitted by Sep 28.

Regards,
Raj Patel
Program Operations, CloudMesh

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudmesh.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Tina Morales <tina.morales@bigbank.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator cascade notice for EU region nodes - action items and timeline

Thanks Raj,

We received the notice and the attachments. High level thoughts and next steps from Redwood side:

- Data residency concern: this will potentially impact our contract with BigBank if control-plane relocation is interpreted as a change in subprocessor topology. We need confirmation that no persistent customer content or logs will be written to operator host disks outside of ephemeral caches that are cleared on process exit. The pdf reference suggests transient cache only but we need explicit assurance and an attestation.
- Compliance artifacts: please share the current SOC2 report, or a link to download, and the operator hardening checklist.
- Mitigations: if CloudMesh cannot provide operator isolation for BigBank workload, we will request a temporary exception (postpone for 90 days) or an alternate routing to keep BigBank on dedicated operator instances.

Internal ask: Marcus and Karthik, can you review the attached region matrix and draft a short exception request (if needed) that we can send to BigBank security by Sep 22? Soojin, can you flag where the SCRM docs need an update and whether this triggers an SAQ?

Raj - please confirm timeline for SOC2 link and whether there is a signed DR runbook we can review.

Mina
VP Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: redline_proposal_platform-residency.docx (placeholder for our draft exception)

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator cascade notice for EU region nodes - action items and timeline

On the region matrix I looked for persistence vectors and control-plane handoffs. Quick notes:
- The operator design doc indicates caches are in-memory KV with TTL and a periodic in-memory checkpoint used for fast warm start. There is an optional disk-backed LRU used only during operator upgrades; CloudMesh states this LRU will be disabled for tenants requesting non-shared tenancy during the migration window. We should get that in writing.
- Suggested exception language (short): Request that BigBank workloads be pinned to dedicated operator tenancy for 90 days post-migration pending SOC2/attestation review, and require explicit confirmation that no operator host persistent storage will contain unencrypted customer content.
- Technical mitigation: request that CloudMesh turn on encrypted tmpfs for any transient spill and provide the exact command/setting they will apply.

Soojin - please add a short update to the vendor roster and SCRM playbook indicating this cascade and add a checklist step for verifying operator LRU disabled.

Marcus
Director, Product Reliability

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudmesh.io>, Operator Notifications <operator-notify@cloudmesh.io>
Cc: Tina Morales <tina.morales@bigbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operator cascade notice for EU region nodes - action items and timeline

Raj,

Thank you for the quick notice. To summarize Redwood and BigBank requirements before we accept the consolidation:
1) CloudMesh must confirm in writing that operator hosts will not persist customer content to host disk, and that any transient spill will be encrypted with a customer-safe cipher.
2) Provide a downloadable SOC2 report or a secure link for Redwood/BigBank to retrieve the report by Sep 24.
3) If CloudMesh cannot provide the assurances in 1 and 2, Redwood will request the 90-day exception for BigBank workloads and expects an alternate routing option to dedicated operator instances.

Please also provide the exact tmpfs/encryption settings you plan to enable and a contact for your compliance team (email and phone). We will deliver a short exception request draft to BigBank security by EOD Sep 22 if needed.

Tina - we are looping you in so you can confirm whether this would breach any contract clauses on residency for BigBank.

Raj, please acknowledge and share the requested artifacts. We will track formally in HubSpot HSP-984732 and in the SCRM roster.

Best,
Mina
VP Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
